system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Five interactive logon failures for leo.martins were recorded on WS-LMARTINS-01 between 13:30:32 and 13:30:56 UTC, each with substatus 0xc000006a, indicating an incorrect password. These failures precede the alert's approximate 13:40 time.
A successful network logon for leo.martins was recorded on WS-NBLAKE-01 at 13:53:41 UTC, with source IP 10.40.10.23. The record does not identify the source host by name.
At 13:57, WS-LMARTINS-01 made a proxy CONNECT request to www.bing.com, and Sysmon recorded Chrome connecting to the proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080.

A cluster of process-termination events occurred on WS-LMARTINS-01 around 14:07, including Zscaler, VS Code, AnyConnect, Dropbox, OneDrive, cmd, Sublime Text, Chrome, and Explorer. A logoff for leo.martins session 0xc121a39 was recorded shortly afterward.

The AnyConnect and Dropbox processes are notable because the supplied inventory says VPN and other cloud-storage services are not approved. These termination records alone do not establish their use for remote access or file transfer.
Explorer registry events show a proxy migration setting at 14:04 and ProxyEnable set to 0 at 14:16. The records do not establish who initiated the change or whether it resulted in proxy bypass.
UserAssist registry entries record paths corresponding to Microsoft Word and Firefox, but do not establish what content was opened or whether either application activity was harmful.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records contain no corresponding successful interactive logon event for the session that later logged off, so the session's start and authentication context are not shown.
There are no process-creation records here to establish how the listed applications were launched, what they did, or what caused their termination.
The source IP in the WS-NBLAKE-01 network-logon record is not mapped to a host in the supplied evidence.
The proxy record shows one CONNECT request but does not reveal the contents of the encrypted session.
The available time window and records do not establish whether the proxy setting change was followed by direct network activity.
claims_not_established: Whether the five incorrect-password attempts were accidental, user-driven, or generated by an attacker.
Whether the network logon to WS-NBLAKE-01 was authorized or which device initiated it.
Whether AnyConnect or Dropbox were used to establish a remote connection or transfer data.
Whether the mass process termination was a normal user logoff, an administrative action, or malicious activity.
Whether the proxy configuration change was intended to evade monitoring.
Whether any data was accessed, altered, or exfiltrated.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve DC-NWD-01 authentication and account-logon records for leo.martins during the window, including the source workstation or IP and any successful logon corresponding to session 0xc121a39.
Identify the device assigned IP 10.40.10.23 at 13:53 and review its authentication and endpoint activity.
Collect process-creation, command-line, parent-process, and endpoint protection telemetry for WS-LMARTINS-01, particularly around 13:30, 13:53, 14:04, and 14:07.
Review proxy and network-flow records for WS-LMARTINS-01 before and after ProxyEnable was set to 0, including any direct connections that bypassed the proxy.
Check software inventory, installation history, and application telemetry for AnyConnect and Dropbox, and determine whether their presence or use was authorized.
Obtain user or IT change records for the session logoff and proxy setting change, if available.
